Job Description
Position Overview:
AI Talent, a pioneer in AI-powered solutions, is looking for a meticulous and experienced Software Tester to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for verifying the quality and performance of our AI applications by creating and executing test plans, identifying defects, and working closely with developers to ensure prompt resolution.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid grasp of software testing methodologies, sharp analytical skills, and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality AI software. Experience with test automation tools is a plus.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with the development team and project stakeholders to understand software requirements and design comprehensive test plans and test cases for AI software applications.
Perform functional, integration, system, and regression testing to validate the performance, accuracy, and reliability of AI software products.
Identify and document software defects, including clear and detailed reproduction steps, in a bug tracking system. Collaborate with the development team to ensure timely resolution of issues.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard software testing automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Appium, or Robot Framework) to streamline testing processes and improve test efficiency for AI software applications.
Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, and test reports, to ensure comprehensive test coverage and facilitate knowledge sharing within the team.
Set up and configure test environments, including hardware, software, and data, to simulate real-world scenarios and ensure accurate testing results.
Continuously evaluate and enhance software testing strategies, methodologies, and tools to improve the overall quality and efficiency of testing processes.
Work closely with the development team, product owners, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify issues, and provide timely feedback on the quality of AI software products.
Collaborate with the QA team to establish and maintain quality standards, best practices, and processes across AI software projects.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and advancements in software testing methodologies, AI technologies, and industry best practices.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Must have at least 2 years of proven experience as a Software Tester, with a strong understanding of software testing methodologies and practices.
Experience in testing AI software applications and familiarity with AI concepts and technologies.
Solid knowledge of test management tools, bug tracking systems, and test automation frameworks.
Experience with software testing automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Robot Framework, or similar.
Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in software testing, such as Python or Java.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and isolate software defects effectively.
Excellent attention to detail and ability to meticulously follow test plans and test cases.
Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Experience with Agile development methodologies is a plus.
Relevant certifications in software testing, such as ISTQB, are desirable.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Salary: $70,000 to $120,000 per year + super

result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching to feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery. 
This position is available from November 2026 or sooner for suitable candidates with a valid AMSA Near Coastal Marine Engine Driver Grade 2/3 Certification, for a placement for up to 4 years.
Vessel Engineer Duties:
The Employee will be required to perform certain duties as listed below whilst at Sea (offshore) and on the Farm Site (inshore), although this list is not exhaustive it is a generalised overview of duties.
Engineer Duties:
•	Engine Room Watchkeeping 
•	Periodical Engine Servicing
•	Maintain machinery to an Operational capacity
•	Use of Pumping Systems
•	Vessel Slipping and Docking
•	Vessel Maintenance/Repairs 
•	Vessel Crane Operation
•	Refuelling & Bunkering
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Reporting to Vessel Master
•	Maintenance and repairs coordinated with Fleet Manager
•	Forklift operation on-shore only (if Licensed)
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending 
•	Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
Also including Deck Hand duties:
Deckhand Duties:
•	Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master 
•	Forklift operation (only if Licensed from previous deployment on SWP)  onshore only
•	Loading and Unloading of vessel at Sea and On-shore
•	Deck Machinery Operation
•	Fish Feeding 
•	Fish Processing and Packing
•	Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
•	Repetitive Manual labour 
•	Vessel cleaning and house keeping 
•	Vessel Mooring/Berthing 
•	Net mending & Rope work (Splicing, Knotting etc.)
•	High Pressure Water Blasting
•	Painting by Hand and/or Spray
•	Farm Pontoon Maintenance
•	Portable hand tool use

The Employee will be required to perform the following additional duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring
A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

Additional Deck Duties:
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

GV Independant Packers Pty Ltd is a family-owned and operated business that has been operating since 1948. The business manages over 1,500 acres of orchards across the Goulburn Valley region, producing a range of apples, pears and stone fruits for the domestic and export markets. We oversee the entire journey of our produce, from production and storage through to packing, marketing and transportation.

GV Independent Packers Pty Ltd is seeking a full-time Fruit Farm Worker to join our team at our orchard in Shepparton, VIC 3630.

The salary offer is $79,423 per annum plus superannuation. 

Main responsibilities include:
•	Preparing, cultivating and fertilising soil to establish and maintain healthy orchards.
•	Planting, training, pruning and thinning fruit trees to promote healthy growth, maximise fruit quality and optimise orchard productivity.
•	Assisting with the operation and maintenance of irrigation systems to ensure an adequate water supply for orchards.
•	Monitoring orchard conditions and inspecting trees for signs of pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies and other crop health issues, and reporting any concerns.
•	Applying fertilisers, herbicides, pesticides and fungicides in accordance with workplace procedures.
•	Performing routine orchard maintenance, including weed control, maintaining tree rows, and erecting and repairing trellises, protective netting and fences.
•	Operating tractors, sprayers and other farm machinery and equipment used for cultivation, fertilising, spraying and general orchard operations.
•	Cleaning and maintaining orchard machinery, irrigation systems, sheds and other farm infrastructure.

Required qualification and experience:
•	At least one year of relevant work experience in a commercial orchard or other primary production environment.
•	A Certificate II in Production Horticulture, Horticulture or Agriculture is highly regarded.

Ideal skills and attributes:
•	Knowledge of commercial orchard production practices. 
•	Ability to perform physically demanding work in an outdoor environment. 
•	Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

# Motor Mechanic

## About Gold Coast Car Electrics & Mechanical

Gold Coast Car Electrics & Mechanical is a trusted independent automotive workshop committed to delivering high-quality mechanical repairs, servicing and diagnostic solutions. We service a wide range of petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles, combining advanced diagnostic technology with skilled workmanship to ensure our customers' vehicles remain safe, reliable and performing at their best.

We are seeking a qualified and motivated **Motor Mechanic** to join our growing team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who takes pride in their workmanship, enjoys solving technical problems and values delivering outstanding customer service.

## Key Responsibilities

As a Motor Mechanic, you will be responsible for:

* Diagnosing mechanical faults using diagnostic equipment and technical expertise.
* Performing servicing, maintenance and repairs on petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
* Inspecting engines, transmissions, suspension, steering, braking and cooling systems to identify faults and determine repair requirements.
* Removing, dismantling, repairing and replacing worn or defective mechanical components.
* Carrying out engine tuning, timing adjustments and performance-related repairs to ensure optimum vehicle operation.
* Inspecting and repairing driveline components, clutches, gearboxes, differentials and exhaust systems.
* Completing scheduled logbook servicing, preventative maintenance and vehicle safety inspections.
* Testing vehicles before and after repairs to verify that faults have been rectified and the vehicle is safe and roadworthy.
* Maintaining accurate service records and clearly communicating repair recommendations to customers and the service team.
* Ensuring all work is completed efficiently while complying with workplace health and safety requirements and industry standards.
* Maintaining a clean, organised and safe workshop environment, including the proper care of tools and equipment.

## Essential Qualifications and Experience

* AQF Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology (or equivalent) with at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV. Alternatively, a minimum of three years of relevant industry experience.
* At least two years' experience as a qualified Motor Mechanic is preferred.
* Current Australian driver's licence (preferred).

## Skills and Attributes

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

* Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills across a wide range of vehicle makes and models.
* Sound knowledge of automotive mechanical systems and manufacturer repair procedures.
* Experience using modern diagnostic scan tools and workshop equipment.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Good organisational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritise workloads.
* The ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
* A strong commitment to quality workmanship, workplace safety and customer satisfaction.

## Employment Details

* **Position:** Permanent Full-Time
* **Salary:** AU$80,000 per annum plus employer superannuation contributions at the statutory rate.
* **Location:** Ashmore, Gold Coast, Queensland
* **Job Type:** Full-time

Job Title: Metallurgical Technician (Metallurgical or Materials Technician - ANZSCO 312912) 
Company: Scidell Pty Ltd, allied company of Multicom Resources Pty Ltd 
Location: St Elmo Site, Julia Creek QLD, Australia 
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time 
Recruitment managed by: Yakr Pty Ltd

About the company:
Our client Scidell Pty Ltd is a scientific delivery alliancing company created to provide professional and cost-effective solutions to Multicom Resources Pty Ltd (Multicom). Scidell’s multi-disciplined scientific and technical project professionals operate from Brisbane and on-site to deliver major projects from initial study through to execution, commissioning, and ongoing expert operational support. 

Multicom is on a mission to bring high-purity critical minerals to the world and become a reliable supplier for global technology manufacturers. Currently, Multicom is progressing the permitting, approval, and development of its 100% owned Saint Elmo Project, situated 25 km east of Julia Creek in Queensland's Northwest Minerals Province , focused on advancing the production of critical assets like vanadium and high-purity alumina (HPA). 

About the role:
As a Metallurgical Technician at Scidell, you will be a key member of the production and operations team responsible for monitoring and improving metallurgical performance targets for the Saint Elmo refinery and mine facility. Working under the direct supervision of the Process Supervisor, you will test materials, operate equipment, and optimize processes to ensure safe, efficient plant operations. This role provides an outstanding opportunity to apply technical data analysis and hands-on testing skills within a highly sophisticated minerals processing environment. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Process Optimization & Monitoring: Monitor various stages of the production process to ensure smooth operations. Check and adjust parameters such as temperature, pressure, flow rates, and chemical concentrations to maximize plant throughput, Vanadium/HPA recovery, and quality costs. 
•	Metallurgical Testing & Surveys: Undertake surveys, coordinate sampling activities, and execute test work to evaluate and identify process improvement opportunities. 
•	Equipment Operations: Start up, shut down, adjust, and operate plant machinery and equipment safely in strict accordance with standard operating procedures (SOPs). 
•	Equipment & Lab Performance: Monitor key equipment across both the process plant and the onsite laboratory to ensure components are optimized and alternative operational methods are assessed. 
•	Quality Control & Data Review: Conduct regular routine inspections and quality control checks on products and materials. Review operating and technical data to identify instances of noncompliance or opportunities for process optimization. 
•	Metallurgical Reporting: Maintain accurate records of equipment operations, process parameters, production, and testing activities. Generate precise metallurgical reconciliations and complete timely daily, weekly, and monthly reports. 
•	Troubleshooting & Technical Support: Identify and troubleshoot basic equipment issues, malfunctions, or process deviations. Provide expert technical support to operations, laboratory teams, and the senior process engineering team, collaborating closely on complex issues. 
•	Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to the Site Safety and Health Management System and all established SOPs, ensuring all safety hazards or incidents are reported promptly. 

Key Requirements:
•	Education: Bachelor's degree in Extractive Metallurgy, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering. 
•	Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar metallurgical or materials testing role, with solid practical experience testing materials within a mineral/metal process and refinery environment. 
•	Licences: Possession of (or the immediate ability to acquire) a Radiation Safety Licence and a Queensland Driver’s Licence (manual preferred). 
•	Technical Skills: Sound understanding of process control systems , mechanical aptitude or a strong interest in hands-on technical roles , and a proven ability to source, gather, interpret, and communicate quantitative and qualitative data. 
•	Personal Attributes: Highly detail-oriented, safety-conscious, willing to learn, and possessing a reliable and consistent work ethic. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow technical instructions accurately. 
•	Pre-Employment Screening: Must be able to pass a comprehensive Pre-Employment Medical examination, including a drug and alcohol screen. 

Why join Scidell?
Scidell offers a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge mineral processing projects while working in a supportive, cooperative, and collaborative environment. Be part of a dedicated team that values safety, high attention to detail, and innovation in delivering critical minerals to global markets. 

How to Apply: 
If you're ready to be part of a dynamic team at Scidell Pty Ltd, dedicated to innovation and excellence, we’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume/CV, ensuring you highlight your relevant material testing, metallurgical data analysis, and engineering experiences. 

Scidell Pty Ltd is an equal-opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. While we appreciate every application, please note that only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
